final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.archstat, s.project_count, 1.0 * s.project_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS share FROM step1 AS s JOIN step2 AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM step3) SELECT s.archstat, s.project_count, s.share, s.share - a.average_share FROM step3 AS s JOIN step4 AS a ON a.average_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.average_share
